scope: Test the only recoverable hidden pressure-algorithm value in the official documentation source after surface integration localized 85 percent of excess drag to pressure.

single_change.name: SIMPLE_nNonOrthogonalCorrectors
single_change.initialization: Copy the reconstructed settled documented ratio-4/no-ft2 state to time zero; change one fvSolution integer only.

fixed.grid: official NASA 897x257 C-grid with independently verified plot3dToFoam topology parity

screen_decision.material_toward_official_plot: last-100 mean Cd decreases by at least 0.00005 relative to source
screen_decision.null_effect: absolute last-100 mean Cd change is at most 0.00002
screen_decision.ambiguous_effect: absolute change is between 0.00002 and 0.00005; retain and diagnose without tuning
screen_decision.residual_report: Report Uy residual and symmetry gates, but do not substitute them for the drag mechanism decision.

terminal_rule: Stop after 1000 iterations. Extend only under a separately declared plan if the material-toward-plot threshold is met; otherwise rule out or retain as ambiguous.
